arms.learned128_int8: frozen 2000-update mean-logit affine 768-to-128 head; signed int8 serving code
arms.learned256_int4: same frozen objective/schedule and width-scaled learning rate; affine 768-to-256 head; train-only 0.999-quantile per-coordinate signed int4 scales
arms.pca128_int8: fit-only centered PCA 768-to-128; signed int8 serving code
arms.pca256_int4: fit-only centered PCA 768-to-256; fit-only 0.999-quantile per-coordinate signed int4 scales

food101.split: official test features partitioned by deterministic class hash, 80% fit / 20% evaluation, seed 17

inshop.split: official train fit, official disjoint query/gallery evaluation; singleton train identities excluded

sop.split: official train fit, official test symmetric evaluation

decision.kill_arm_if: on any dataset its paired mAP@R interval against pca128_int8 includes zero, or its point effect is below 0.005
decision.outer_width_contrast: also report learned256_int4 minus learned128_int8 with the identical paired bootstrap; do not use it to rescue an arm killed against the reference
decision.survive_arm_if: paired mAP@R lower endpoint is strictly positive and point effect is at least 0.005 on every dataset

prohibitions: no dataset-specific optimizer, schedule, seed, scale quantile, or metric tuning
no scorer-family or augmentation work before this ladder is terminal
no CUDA kernel work from quality-only evidence
